results.title: IST Interview: Anjan Umamaheswaran B, Founder of CuriousCats.ai, on Building a Personal Intelligence Layer for the Internet
results.description: The internet has made information more accessible than ever, but staying informed has become increasingly fragmented. News apps, newsletters, social media, YouTube and search platforms each provide a different piece of the picture, forcing users to constantly switch between platforms to understand what is happening.
